name: Our Lady of the Rosary
history: On 7 October 1571 a Christian fleet defeated the Ottoman navy at Lepanto, while confraternities across Europe prayed the Rosary at Pope Pius V's request. He instituted a feast of Our Lady of Victory, later renamed Our Lady of the Rosary. October became the month of the Rosary.
meditation: Pray one decade slowly today. Let each Hail Mary be one step beside Our Lady through the life of her Son.
prayer: O God, Whose only-begotten Son, by His life, death and resurrection, has merited for us the grace of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that, meditating on those mysteries in the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise. Through the same Christ our Lord…
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
